scientific_integrity: One exact theorem on arbitrary nonnegative conductance allocations; global optimum established analytically by averaging and spectral block reduction. Self-review only, no claim of independent scientific validation or publication priority.
scientific_limitations: n>=3 and m>=2; one common hub for all leaves
Unweighted total conductance budget, no per-edge bounds
All-optima support dichotomy, not full classification of nonsymmetric optimizers
Bounded literature checks leave residual originality uncertainty
Finite numerical tests do not replace the infinite analytic proof
title: Sharp clique-edge activation threshold for fastest mixing on pineapple graphs
